calculation.description: Momentum-of-momentum factor: difference between 10-day return and 30-day return at each point. Positive values indicate an asset whose short-term return exceeds its medium-term return (accelerating); negative values indicate deceleration. Forward predictive power is positive: accelerating assets tend to continue outperforming over the next 10 trading days.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2033-12-08 through 2035-11-07 on 15 cross-asset instruments covering equity indices, commodities, crypto, and yield series. Period captures multiple market regimes. Factor shows strongest predictive power at 10d horizon, moderate at 5d, diminishing at 20d.
